wallet.defaultEvmAccountHint: Preferred network, default signing address, and published receiving address for DMs, profile, and squad operations.
wallet.addSquadAccountFirst: Add a squad EVM account below before editing defaults.
wallet.onlyDerivedSquadAccounts: Only derived squad accounts can be signer or receiver.
wallet.chooseSignerAndReceiver: Choose a signer and receiver from your squad accounts.
wallet.receivingAddressSaved: Receiving address saved. Publishing profile metadata…
wallet.squadEvmAccountsHint: Derived squad keys are assigned per squad for squad EVM, treasury, and governance. Set your default signer and receiver in {defaultEvmAccount} above.
wallet.evmAccountsHint: Derived squad keys power DM wallet, squad EVM shares, treasury deploy, and governance. Advanced imported keys are for experimental contract calls only.
wallet.noSquadEvmAccounts: No squad EVM accounts yet. Unlock your wallet or add one from your recovery phrase.
wallet.noEvmAccounts: No EVM accounts yet. Unlock your wallet or add one from your recovery phrase.
wallet.advancedEvmAccountsHint: Experimental keys for opaque contract calls — not linked to squads or your profile.
wallet.sendDesc: Send from your embedded wallet to any {0x} address on the selected network. Confirm signs and broadcasts in the desktop app; confirmation continues in the background after the modal closes.
wallet.insufficientFunds: This amount is more than your {assetCode} balance on this network. Available: {balanceDecimal} {assetCode}.
wallet.couldNotLoadBalance: Could not load your balance ({error}). You can still try to send.
wallet.couldNotLoadBalanceStillTry: Could not load your balance ({error}). You can still try to send; the network will reject if funds are insufficient.
wallet.enterAmountForUsd: Enter an amount to see USD estimate.
wallet.usdUnavailable: USD estimate unavailable for this asset.
wallet.retryHint: The transaction may still confirm. Check the explorer before sending again.
wallet.sendStubDesc: Send assets to {peerName} from your embedded wallet (desktop app). Confirm signs and broadcasts the transaction; the payment card appears in chat while confirmation finishes in the background. Your contact must have an EVM address on their profile.
wallet.requestStubDesc: Request a payment from {peerName}. Confirm posts a payment request card in this chat (desktop app). They can accept to open Send with your amount pre-filled.
wallet.paymentRequestDesktopOnly: Payment requests can only be sent from the desktop app in an open DM.
wallet.noActiveEvmAccount: No active EVM account. Set up accounts under Settings → EVM.
wallet.couldNotDeliverRequest: Could not deliver the request. Check your connection and try again.
wallet.couldNotSendPaymentRequest: Could not send the payment request.
wallet.receiveDesc: Share this address to receive ETH and supported tokens on EVM networks where your wallet is active.
wallet.walletBarReadyHint: Send and Request use this contact. Use the wallet button in the chat header to hide this panel.
wallet.walletBarNotReadyHint: First exchange payout addresses privately with this contact, then you can send or request payment.
wallet.couldNotRefreshBalances: Could not refresh balances. Showing last known amounts.
wallet.exchangeAddressesHint: Their payout address for this chat is not on your device yet. Send a private request to exchange addresses. When they accept, both of you can send to each other.
wallet.alreadyHavePayoutAddress: You already have a payout address for this contact.
wallet.useDesktopAppForRequest: Use the desktop app to send this request.
wallet.addOrSelectWallet: Add or select a wallet before requesting theirs.
wallet.requestSent: Request sent. Waiting for your contact to accept.
wallet.couldNotSendRequest: Could not send the request. Check your connection.
wallet.importTokensDesc: Choose tokens from the catalog or add a contract manually. Balances and Send use this list for the selected networks.
wallet.signInToManageTokens: Sign in to manage imported tokens.
wallet.tokenSecurityHint: Only the address format is checked. Malicious tokens exist; verify the contract before sending.
wallet.advancedBannerTitle: Advanced — not linked to any squad.
wallet.advancedBannerBody: Opaque contract calls use your advanced-purpose key only. No squad EVM shares, governance announces, or dashboard entries.
wallet.advancedBannerExternalWallet: For importing keys into MetaMask or similar, see {externalWallet} above.
wallet.advancedNoSignerHint: Create or select an advanced account above before sending. Squad signers cannot use this panel.
wallet.advancedSignerHint: Signing as {address}. Simulate with {ethCall}, then confirm the full calldata before broadcast.
wallet.advancedInfraWarning: This address matches local squad infrastructure. Advanced calls to squad deploy targets are discouraged.
wallet.advancedVerifyEveryField: This transaction is not squad-linked. Verify every field.
wallet.peerRequestOutBody: Waiting for {peerName} to accept or decline.
wallet.peerGrantOutBody: You shared your payout address with {peerName}.
wallet.peerDeclineOutBody: You chose not to exchange wallet addresses with {peerName}.
wallet.peerRequestedPayment: {peerName} requested you send this amount (their account {fromAddrShort}).
wallet.matchingTransferPosted: A matching transfer was posted in this chat.
wallet.waitingForResponse: Waiting for the other person to respond.
wallet.peerDeclinedRequest: {peerName} declined this payment request. You can follow up in chat or send another request later.
wallet.youDeclinedRequest: You declined. No automatic message was sent to {peerName}.
wallet.evmWalletLead: Your embedded EVM wallet: send to any address, receive by sharing your address, and manage networks and tokens. Payment requests with contacts stay in {dms} (in-chat wallet panel). Nostr profile, backup, and logout: {settings}.
wallet.unlockWalletHint: Unlock or wait for your wallet address to load to use Send and Receive.
wallet.alphaSoftware: Alpha software. Wallet and key handling have not been reviewed by an independent security audit. Use only funds you can afford to lose. See {docsPath} in the repository.
wallet.advancedAccountWarning: Advanced accounts are not used for squad EVM, governance, treasury deploy, or your profile receiving address.
wallet.advancedAccountCreateHint: Creates a new derived address from your recovery phrase, tagged advanced-only.
wallet.squadAccountCreateHint: Creates a new squad address from your recovery phrase. Name is optional and only stored on this device.
wallet.advancedAccountEditHint: Update the display name. Advanced accounts cannot be squad signers or receiving addresses.
wallet.squadAccountEditHintSettings: Update the display name. Signer and receiver are set in Default EVM account above.
wallet.squadAccountEditHint: Update the display name and whether this account is the signer or published receiving address. Name is only stored on this device.
wallet.useAsSigningAddress: Use as signing address (Send, balances, DM wallet)
wallet.useAsReceivingAddress: Use as receiving address (profile / Kind 0; republishes your profile)
wallet.importedKeyWarning: Imported keys are always advanced-purpose. They cannot be squad signers, squad EVM addresses, or profile receiving addresses.
wallet.importedKeyHint: Paste a standalone Ethereum private key (32-byte secret). It is encrypted like your other keys. Not recoverable from your recovery phrase.
wallet.advancedAccountImported: Advanced account imported. Not used for squad EVM or governance.
wallet.paymentRequestDeclinedToast: Payment request declined. The requester was not notified.
wallet.dmTransfer.noteNotRelayed: Transfer confirmed, but the payment note could not be relayed.
wallet.dmTransfer.noteSkippedNoAddress: Transfer submitted, but the payment note was skipped (no active EVM address).
wallet.dmTransfer.awaitingConfirmation: Submitted — still waiting for confirmation. Check the explorer from the chat card.
wallet.peerExchange.alreadyDeclinedToast: You already declined this request. Ask them to send a new one.
wallet.peerExchange.requestMismatchToast: This request does not match this conversation.
wallet.peerExchange.selectWalletToast: Add or select a wallet, then tap Accept to share your address.
wallet.peerExchange.sendAddressFailedToa: Could not send your address. Tap Accept to try again.
wallet.peerExchange.addressSharedToast: Your address was shared. Waiting for theirs.
